title: Suspect
description: Fused judgement about one subject after Jev (or the rules fallback). Carries P(fault), rank, fault kind and the verdict state. Probabilities are shown to users as words until calibration_validated is true (I6).

p_fault.description: P(this subject is the cause or part of the cause of the symptom).

p_fault_word.description: Word shown to the user. Mapping from p_fault lives in code (policy.json).

probabilities.description: Option -> probability. Options for a wire: unplugged, wrong_pin_or_colour_order, broken_or_missing, damaged_insulation, ok, not_enough_evidence.

option_order_seed.description: Seed used to shuffle options (Jev leans to the first option).

verdict.description: confirmed and cleared require a meter reading for electrical subjects (I2).

proof_reading_id.description: MeterReading that confirmed or cleared this subject. Null while unproven.

calibration_validated.description: True only after a reliability diagram on our labelled scans for this product class. Until then the UI shows p_fault_word only.

grain_verdict.description: Grain diagnose verdict for the same part (GrainDiagnoseResponse parts[].verdict, joined on parts[].name = subject.ref), if any. Kept separate; advisory when design_trust is low. null when Grain has no row for it.

grain_fix.description: The Grain /call fix merged into this suspect, if any (joined by part name, wire name or net name until T3 adds fixes[].subject).

subject.description: Same as Finding.subject: ref is the Grain part name (model.glb node), harness wire name or net name.
